doc.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Closing and plugs for Pearl's and Sonny Buxton
summary: Thanks and goodbyes, plus his upcoming gigs and Sonny Buxton's radio show.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been a real pleasure for me.
Same here. Same here. Early in the morning, once we get going, it just gets going. Fortunately I live down the street, I’m two blocks away, which is real cool.
Well great, I hope I see you at Pearl’s maybe before we leave.

Yeah I’m trying to think, I’ll be there tonight with a saxophone player from L.A., a guy named Bruce Escovitz, who happens to be teaching at the Stanford Jazz Workshop. I saw him yesterday. And so he’s playing with us — us being a kind of put together rhythm section. And then the weekend, I don’t know who’s there this weekend, but there’s always good music there. And talk to the guy that runs the joint, Sonny Buxton, a very interesting man. He’s got his own radio show on Saturdays. You might catch him Saturday between ten and two on KCSM 91.1. He’s got a good show.
Great. All right well thanks for your time today.
All right you’re welcome. Thank you.
